ABS Outstanding : It was reported by vessel's management that the MOB combined smoke & light signal in Port bridge wing found damage during routine. MOB Self activating Smoke signals found that mounting post broken causing the smoke signal to release from its bracket post and fall to the C deck causing the smoke signal damage, below listed conditions were confirmed by master. 
1. MOB combined smoke & light signal in Starboard bridge wing is in good condition,
2. Risk assessment was carried out with appropriate risk control measures,
3. Briefed all crew onboard and made them aware of the above defect,
4. Entries was made in official logbook for this defect,
5. Muster list onboard was amended to take effect of the above defect,
6. New MOB combined smoke & light signal was ordered through company's system. 
Master was advised that The Master shall notify the relevant port authorities regarding the defect when calling at a port. 
As per Singapore SHIPPING CIRCULAR NO. 10 OF 2025, the survey performed by remotely based on information provided by the owner and
Vessel master, Short Term Cargo Ship Safety Equipment Certificate valid until 08 December 2026 was issued pending replacement of damaged MOB combined smoke & light signal. 
Follow documents, photos provided by Master was reviewed and found satisfactory.
1. Master's attestation
2. Damage report
3. Repair plan
4. Training record & briefing for all navigation watch crew for the defect
5. Risk assessment
6. Amended Muster listed
7. Copy of Logbook entry
8. Photo of the MOB combined smoke & light signal in starboard bridge wing
